purpose: Test whether externally annotated nested key/complete evidence sets are reproducible and learnable before enabling any collaborative prior, gate, or reconstruction loss.

source.reuse_scope: the 64 already-vetted trajectory identities and their frozen dense_train/localization_dev memberships; no prior key/complete decision exists or is reused

unitization.boundaries: non-empty lines and sentence-final punctuation; common Step N:/Answer: prefixes are separated
unitization.coverage: every non-whitespace trajectory character belongs to exactly one fixed unit
unitization.fallback: mark insufficient_unitization instead of inventing or editing a span

target_semantics.complete: the non-redundant candidate-side reasoning units needed to reconstruct and audit how the trajectory reaches its conclusion from the supplied prompt
target_semantics.key: the smallest subset of complete units whose verification most directly determines whether the conclusion is warranted
target_semantics.nesting: key_unit_indices must be a subset of complete_unit_indices
target_semantics.incorrect_trajectory_rule: label the decisive erroneous or unsupported inference as key and retain the material attempted chain as complete; do not convert this task into a correctness label
target_semantics.correct_trajectory_rule: label the decisive answer-producing inference as key and the minimal sufficient derivation chain as complete
target_semantics.final_answer_rule: a pure duplicate final-answer wrapper is neither; include it only when it is the sole unit that states the conclusion, and never treat an answer-only trajectory as auditable reasoning
target_semantics.prompt_restatement_rule: a unit that merely copies the prompt is neither unless it also performs a material transformation or inference
target_semantics.redundancy_rule: select one sufficient derivation, not every paraphrase or duplicated calculation

selection_gate.scope: module-development gate, not a paper-quality reliability claim
selection_gate.disagreements: adjudicate before materializing training targets; a failed agreement gate triggers guide/unitization repair and does not silently average labels

first_training_pilot.reason: direct external target learnability must be established before adding collaboration losses whose shortcut is key/complete collapse

token_mapping.contract: retokenize the exact visible response and require prefix equality with frozen output_token_ids; map selected unit character spans to overlapping frozen tokens
